verdict.rationale: SAM.gov publishes first-party APIs covering many UI data domains: entities, opportunities, exclusions, contracts, Federal Hierarchy and Assistance Listings, plus filtering, pagination and bulk extracts. However, the evidence shows only read/search access, with no API for UI actions such as entity registration or wage determinations, so full UI parity is not shown. Missing for 10: evidence of write/transactional API parity (e.g., entity registration via API), a Wage Determinations API, an explicit statement of UI-API parity, and independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI

citations.quote: Get Opportunities API provides all the published opportunity details based on the request parameters. This API supports pagination as needed.
API to retrieve Exclusion detail information from SAM.gov using various searchable parameters.
API to retrieve list of contracts from SAM.gov using various searchable parameters.
Federal Hierarchy public API allows non-federal users to obtain Federal Organization details
The Assistance Listings Public API provides Active and Inactive federal assistance listings data, similar to the CFDA catalog.
It offers several optional search parameters, filtering by sections, AND (&), OR (~), NOT (!) conditions and a free text search q to obtain the desired data.
